Six later runs gave 116/0, three of them under slot load. If it comes back in the queue, it is an intermittent acceptance case, not a hang.

lessons: A test that replaces `time.sleep` replaces it for `subprocess`'s own waits too; a test should replace a seam owned by the code under test. Also, `nproc` follows heavy_slot's OMP_NUM_THREADS, so a load generator needs `OMP_NUM_THREADS= nproc`.
